_description: The evidence for the 480 thumns of the Qālūn muṣḥaf: the divisions the printed muṣḥaf marks only in its margin. The build adds them to the ۞ the docx prints inline and to the opening of the Qurʾān at 1:1, and gets 437 − 1 + 43 + 1 = 480; it fails if that total does not close (pipeline/qurantext/divisions.py). The result is published as `hizb_starts` and `thumn_starts` in data/mushaf/qalun.json. Nothing here is a word number: each entry is keyed by this edition's own `ayah`, and its division starts at that āyah's first word. `page` is this edition's. First assembled by haythemgataa (#53, #63), who found the five places where the print has an inline ۞ that the docx lacks or misplaces; those carry `inline_in_print`.
_checked: Every label in the print was located, not only the ones listed here: each page was rendered, each label in the outer margin was found by its position, and its page and row were matched to the data. All 479 labels fell on a ۞ or on an entry below, and no label was left over. Then the label at every ḥizb start, and every label listed here, was read.
_labels: `label` is the margin text as printed, without its vowel marks. This print words its labels: «حزب» at a ḥizb start, also where a juz starts, then «ثمن», «ربع», «ثمن», «نصف», «ثمن», «ربع», «ثمن». The third quarter reads «ربع», not «ثلاثة أرباع», and no label carries a number; the running head of each page names the ḥizb.

not_a_division.note: the docx prints its ۞ here; the print has it one āyah earlier, at 39:50 (docs/known-issues.md §7)

_juz: Where the print starts a juz at a different āyah from the v2 CSV's `jozz` column. `juz_starts` still follows the CSV (docs/known-issues.md §11); `hizb_starts` follows the print.
